question: In a certain number of years T, the simple interest earned on a certain sum at rate of 9% per annum is nine-sixteenth of the sum. What is the value of T (in years)?
solution:
Formula:

SI = Ptimes Rtimes Tover100

where-

P = Principal

SI = Simple Interest

R = Rate

T = Time

Calculation:

According to the question-

⇒ 9over16P = Ptimes 9times Tover100

⇒ T = 100over 16 years = 61over4 years.
